train_behavior_cloning_agent: train a behavior cloning agent for Habitat ObjectNav-v1 using the ILEnvTrainer with rollout collection and checkpointing
eval_checkpoint_metrics: evaluate a single ILEnvTrainer checkpoint and log average reward, SPL, and success metrics to WandB
setup_actor_critic_agent: set up an ILAgent with a policy from config, observation transforms, and optimizer parameters
save_load_checkpoint: save or load an ILEnvTrainer checkpoint containing agent state dict and config to or from disk
extract_scalars_from_infos: extract scalar metrics from a list of environment info dicts while filtering blacklisted keys
